observed_behavior: A campaign-dependency-ready plan could receive a worker despite having no runnable product tasklets.
expected_behavior: Worker dispatch requires satisfied campaign prerequisites and a nonempty canonical immediately-ready tasklet set.
causal_mechanism: The scheduler projected only campaign-level prerequisites and never consumed execution-sprint or tasklet readiness.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A coarse scheduling gate omitted the owned finer-grained readiness contract.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Satisfied plan dependencies do not establish reviewed, executable work inside the plan.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: One canonical joined readiness predicate governs the summary and all product dispatch decisions.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: The census reuses canonical sprint and tasklet selectors; both dispatch engines and unstarted retry validation consume the same nonempty projection.

applicability_conditions: Plans contain independently gated sprints and tasklets.
known_non_matches: Delivered rebase and integration remain executable without further product tasklets.
confirmation_evidence: Real-Git CLI proof excludes dependency-blocked, unreviewed, and exhausted plans; batch proof reserves fifteen eligible plans once.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: runnable-plans joins satisfied plan dependencies with nonempty canonical tasklet readiness
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: tasklet exhaustion suppresses new, queued, and unstarted dispatch without changing started identity
